inputs_sent.prompt: A man sits at a small wooden desk in a bedroom in warm sunrise light, seen from behind his left shoulder. He reads the open laptop in front of him and types a few words, then rests his hands and keeps reading, with a calm, contented, small closed-lip smile and one slow blink. Small, natural, relaxed movements only: his breathing, his eyes, his fingers. The laptop's screen stays a plain, softly glowing light cream with no text. The phone lies still on the desk. The curtains sway very slightly. The camera is locked on a tripod and does not move. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no music, no subtitles and no text.
